internal_transport_clock: UTC-aware datetime (timezone.utc) for all freshness/skew/age math; to_utc_aware() normalizes naive -> UTC without shifting wall clock
strategy_session_clock: raw bar hour + fixed UTC-5 (est_hour=(hour-5)%24), NO DST correction, NO America/New_York, NO broker-local
mixing_guard: no naive-datetime subtraction across mixed tz-awareness (all comparisons go through to_utc_aware)

tables.canonical_research_timestamp: raw bar open time from CSV (naive, server time) — used verbatim as strategy key
tables.broker_timestamp: MT5 copy_rates open time / symbol_info_tick time — normalized to UTC-aware for transport
tables.runtime_timestamp: datetime.now(timezone.utc) receipt time — recorded alongside broker time
tables.session_classification_timestamp: raw bar hour with fixed UTC-5 (same object as the strategy key)
